query:
INSERT INTO news (title, slug, excerpt, date, categoryId, coverImageUrl, blocks)
VALUES (
  'Jersey Boys',
  'jersey-boys-pioneer-theatre',
  'Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for Pioneer Theatre Company''s production of Jersey Boys, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for Jo Winiarski''s dynamic scenic design that transported audiences from smoky clubs to sold-out arenas.',
  '2024-09-13',
  (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Assistant Scenic Design' LIMIT 1),
  'https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/placeholder-scenic.jpg',
  '[
    {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for Pioneer Theatre Company''s production of Jersey Boys, the Tony Award-winning musical that chronicles the rise of Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons. Working with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, Davis provided drafting and 3D modeling support for a dynamic design that transported audiences from 1950s New Jersey to sold-out concert arenas."},
    {"type":"header","content":"The Production"},
    {"type":"text","content":"This four-time Tony Award-winning musical tells the story of four boys from New Jersey who became one of the most successful bands in pop music history. The scenic design supported the show''s rapid transitions through time and location, from humble beginnings in smoky clubs to the heights of stardom at major venues."},
    {"type":"team","title":"Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Karen Azenberg","role":"Director"},{"name":"Phil Reno","role":"Musical Director/Conductor"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brenda Van der Wiel","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Christina Watanabe","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Aaron Hubbard","role":"Sound Designer"}]},
    {"type":"link","url":"https://pioneertheatre.org/production/jersey-boys/","text":"Visit Pioneer Theatre Company"}
  ]'
);
